primary_outcome: Provider-reported input-token reduction; ratio of balanced condition means.
analysis_unit: 10 task families, 2 scenes per family; repeats are not independent tasks.
uncertainty: Exploratory family-cluster bootstrap, 10000 resamples, fixed seed 2026102702; report family values and scene paired deltas.
subgroup: 5 previously used families / 5 newly added families, reported separately; all 20 inputs newly created.
order: Three rounds; 10 AB and 10 BA pairs per round; per scene ordering is 2:1 or 1:2, not perfectly balanced.
stopping: 120 attempt cap; checkpoints after 40/80/120. No stopping for favorable outcomes, no automatic retry. Stop on billing/transport/unknown usage errors.
checkpoint_rule: No prompt or label changes after execution starts. Any repair creates a new protocol revision and separate cohort.
budget_status: Planning limit only; no live runner in this package. Verify actual account balance/prices and configure enforceable budget ledger before launch.
price_estimate_basis: Prior schema cohort mean list-price estimate per request, scaled to 120; not a quote or invoice.
boundaries: Synthetic images only; not native RoboDojo observations.
Zero joint states; geometry/physics not validated.
Labels assigned from descriptions by preparation author; no independent human labels.
Instruction alone often reveals the family; this is not a visual grounding benchmark.
Same 22-operation catalogue means input savings need not generalize to other catalogues.
No simulation, VLA execution, training, System 2 improvement, or robot task success.
The schema addition is an adaptation, not unmodified official behavior.
